leadText: Volume 6: Gold & Silver is the sixth of ten volumes of the Magical Pokémon Journey manga created by Yumi Tsukirino.
plainText:
Volume 6: Gold & Silver is the sixth of ten volumes of the Magical Pokémon Journey manga created by Yumi Tsukirino.

==Blurb==
IN THIS VOLUME SEVERAL NEW GOLD & SILVER POKÉMON MAKE THEIR DEBUT! PLUS…
Repressed falls in love and follows the questionable romantic advice of Hazel and Coconut.
 arrives on the scene in the form of an egg, and and do the hatching.
Hazel and Almond babysit a wild herd of for a Pokémon trainer who is even more boy-crash than Hazel and Coconut! Really!
Chikorita arrives on the scene and challenges to win Pistachio's heart.
A ghost and its are reunited after many long, lonely years.
And more stories starring , , , , and all your most favorite characters!

==Trivia==
This volume contains two "Bonus Bonus" chapters:
Pokémon File!: An overview of each human and Pokémon who debuted in Volume 6.
Yumi Tsukirino's Road to Becoming A Pokémon Master!!: Tsukirino describes her experiences playing Pokémon Gold and Silver, including her worries of her upcoming battle with , and her struggle to capture one of every .
In a "P.S." section, Tsukirino announces that she will no longer include joke previews for future volumes. This is due to the negative feedback she had received from young readers who felt they were being misled.
